_readme: Curated looks. Put the image in content/looks-src/<file>, edit the entry, then run `npm run looks`. id defaults to the file name (men-01-slicked-back.jpg -> men-01-slicked-back). audience: men | women | any. length: short | medium | long. hairType: 1a-4c. faceShapes (optional): oval round square heart oblong diamond. tags: only words from lib/style.ts STYLE_TAGS. Set "illustrative": true for AI-made or stand-in images.

looks.name: Slicked-back side part
looks.description: Short sides with length on top combed back and to the side with a defined part. Ask for a classic taper at the sides and enough length on top to comb, finished with a glossy pomade.

looks.name: Curly top with fade
looks.description: Tight curls kept full on top with a skin fade that blends up the sides and a sharp line-up. Ask for the curls to be cut dry so the shape follows how they spring.

looks.name: Long layered flow
looks.description: Shoulder-length waves with loose layers through the mid-lengths and no hard lines. Ask for light layering to remove weight, and trim only the ends to keep the length.

looks.name: Classic taper
looks.description: A clean taper that tightens gently from the sides into the neckline, with length on top brushed across. Ask for scissor-over-comb blending rather than a hard fade.

looks.name: French crop
looks.description: A short, textured top cut forward into a straight fringe, with a low fade at the sides. Ask for point-cutting through the top so the fringe sits choppy and a blunt fringe line.

looks.name: Curtain cut
looks.description: Mid-length hair parted in the middle and falling to each side. Ask for long layers around the face so the curtains frame the cheekbones, and keep the ends soft.

looks.name: Modern pompadour
looks.description: Height swept up and back from the front with a faded, tidy side. Ask for length on top, a mid fade and a blow-dry with a little hold to build the volume.

looks.name: Buzz cut with fade
looks.description: An even clipper cut on top with a slightly tighter fade at the sides and a natural hairline. Ask for a guard length on top and a clean neckline, and a zero-to-one blend at the sides.

looks.name: Long layers
looks.description: Long, glossy hair with long layers that fall in a soft V at the back. Ask for layers that start below the shoulders so the length stays and the ends keep their weight.

looks.name: Sleek blunt bob
looks.description: A jaw-length bob cut to one sharp line with a smooth finish. Ask for no layers and the line to sit just at the jaw, with a side part and a polished blow-dry.

looks.name: Curtain bangs with layers
looks.description: Shoulder-length hair with face-framing layers and soft curtain bangs parted at the centre. Ask for the bangs to blend into the layers, not sit as a separate shelf.

looks.name: Wavy lob
looks.description: A collarbone-length cut with soft, tousled waves and sun-kissed dimension. Ask for a slightly shorter back, a few light layers and waves set with a large barrel.

looks.name: Textured pixie
looks.description: Short and piecey with a longer top that sweeps across the forehead and tidy sides. Ask to keep the nape neat and the top texturised so it holds shape without much product.

looks.name: Shaggy layers with fringe
looks.description: Choppy layers through the length with a wispy fringe and plenty of movement. Ask for shorter layers around the crown, a soft fringe and texture through the ends.

looks.name: Sleek low bun
looks.description: Hair smoothed back into a low twisted bun at the nape. Ask for a centre or soft side part and long layers, so the bun sits full without bulk at the crown.

looks.name: Voluminous curls
looks.description: Big, bouncy curls with lots of volume at the crown and soft definition through the lengths. Ask for a dry cut with round layering so the shape stays full and not triangular.
